title: Stunning Home w Pickleball & Basketball Court
description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.  No need to leave the property to be entertained as here you'll find a pickleball/basketball court, swimming pool & spa, plenty of patio space, pool table with ping-pong surface as well, theatre/TV room, game room with electric piano, 3 master suites each with their own walk-in showers and closets, and spacious spaces for family gatherings. Central location close to 60 and 202 Freeways.
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated
